example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মুখ থেকে শুধু কাঁচা কথা বেরোচ্ছে।
এসব কাঁচা কথায় সময় নষ্ট করো না।
example_sentences_in_english: He's just spouting senseless words from his mouth.
Don't waste time on this worthless talk.
note: The idiom draws from the metaphor of 'raw' implying unrefined or immature, common in Bengali linguistic expressions.
